items.title: Orient Express Sailing Yachts Review: Corinthian’s Suites, Dining, Amenities, Service, And More
items.why: Ultra-luxury sailing is a niche, high-ticket experience worth noting when scouting top-tier travel partners.
items.summary_ai: A reviewer spent four nights aboard Corinthian, the first Orient Express Sailing Yacht, and rated its suites, dining and service highly.
items.take: Ultra-luxury sailing is a niche, high-ticket experience worth noting when scouting top-tier travel partners.
